hook: A Miami investment firm just collapsed after a $500 million fraud.

sections.voiceover: A Miami investment firm just collapsed after a $500 million fraud.
The co-founder of 777 Partners, Josh Wander, orchestrated this massive scheme to deceive his investors. How did he mislead lenders and investors to secure that $500 million?
Federal prosecutors in the Southern District of New York uncovered his scheme to bilk investors.
Wander pleaded guilty to these charges in a Manhattan federal court. This $500 million fraud scheme directly triggered the total collapse of the Miami investment firm.
He must now pay back $500 million in losses as part of his plea agreement.
